The lattice distortions δ (δ = a-a0/a0) of B2 and L12 phases are up to 0.41 % and 0.40 %, respectively, which can be attributed to the solution of Ti element with a large atomic radius. This could strengthen the intermetallic phases significantly, resulting in the improved mechanical properties.
The superior RT mechanical properties are mainly attributed to the solution strengthening by Ti element

The nano-sized η particles densely precipitated in the B2 phase can effectively strengthen the multi-fold composite structure, leading to the high hardness of 650 HV and super-high YS of about 1900 MPa at room-temperature.
precipitation strengthening by η phase
the precipitation of the η phase can strengthen the B2 phase effectively without sacrifice of plasticity, due to the special orientation-relationship (OR) between the B2 and η phase
The superior mechanical properties can be attributed to the solution and precipitation strengthening effects as well as the synergistic deformation of composite structure.
